viewing_check: Estimate 60-100, no current bid shown. Four photos viewed; a sticker reads Made in India on a tile, the numerals look like modern Indian/Mediterranean craft tiles, and the framed Delft-style tiles look like modern reproductions (no De Porceleyne Fles or Makkum mark visible). Check on viewing for a maker mark on the back of the framed tiles; if one says De Porceleyne Fles or Westraven that adds only about A$40-50 each. Number tiles sell in 1s and 2s for A$9-27, so the many loose tiles are a slow, low-value sell. Prices are 2024-2026, steady.
